description: This Rust source file provides functions for detecting MIME types based on file signatures (magic bytes), converting binary data to data URLs with base64 encoding, and generating JSON values from binary data. It includes unit tests for these functions.

methods.name: detect_mime_type
methods.description: Detects MIME type based on file signature bytes.

methods.name: vec_to_data_uri
methods.description: Converts binary data to a data URL string, auto-detecting MIME type.

methods.name: vec_to_data_uri_with_mime
methods.description: Converts binary data to a data URL string with a specified MIME type.

methods.name: vec_to_data_uri_value
methods.description: Converts binary data to a JSON string value representing the data URL.
